description: Lifecycle hooks, subagent enforcement and Double-Gatekeeper protocol configuration for Next.js monorepo

pre_branch.description: Validates monorepo structural compliance and branch naming conventions before branch creation

post_init.description: Gatekeeper 1 (Pre-Code Architecture Review): Architect validates and approves 4-layer file placement and design in Solution Spec before writing code

pre_commit.description: Gatekeeper 2 (Post-Code Diff Audit): Architect audits written diff for 4-layer compliance, zero forbidden patterns (direct pg in Presentation), and clean monorepo root

preflight.description: Runs automated validation suite (pnpm validate) and clean-code audit pass

gate_1_pre_code.requirement: Architect must validate and approve projected 4-layer file paths in Solution Spec before coding

gate_2_post_code.requirement: Architect must audit final diff for layer isolation, clean root, and forbidden patterns before commit
